summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of Reelm streaming discovery MVP. All 15 backend pytest tests pass (auth, services, genres, preferences, discover, movie detail, actions with re-categorization, watchlist, watched, savings, AI explain via GPT-5.2). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: landing, register form, login, discover card stack with action buttons, bottom nav, watchlist, savings, profile, logout, and protected-route redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] + allow_origin_regex='.*' is permissive; browsers still block credentials with literal '*', but allow_origin_regex='.*' effectively reflects any origin. Acceptable for preview, but for production restrict to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin(s).
Cookies use samesite='none', secure=True - correct for cross-site preview domain; confirms httpOnly set. Good.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook suggests lockout after 5 fails). Low priority for MVP but worth noting.
/api/auth/refresh endpoint mentioned in test_credentials.md but NOT implemented in server.py — cookie max-age is 30 days so refresh currently relies on new login. If intended per spec, add it.
seed_admin correctly updates password if changed — verified.
server.py is a single ~525-line file — acceptable, but if features grow, split into routers/modules.
Discover sort is deterministic by score; adding a tie-breaker (e.g., random or id) may improve perceived variety on repeat opens.
test_credentials: admin@reelm.app / admin123 (seeded); new users registered dynamically via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: None beyond default seed; test users created with uuid-random emails to avoid conflicts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 15 tests cover auth (register/login/me/logout/google-session-missing), reference data (services=8, genres=14), preferences, discover filtering by subscription, movie detail, action state transitions (save/skip/watched/unsave with re-categorization), watchlist, watched, savings (total_monthly, total_yearly, usage, suggestions, overlap_titles), and /api/recommendations/explain (GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key). Frontend uses data-testid prefixes: discover-page, discover-card-top, btn-skip/watched/info/save, bottom-nav, tab-discover/watchlist/savings/profile. Auth uses httpOnly cookies with samesite=none,secure=true AND Authorization Bearer; tests use Bearer header. Google OAuth path untested (requires real Emergent callback). /api/auth/refresh is mentioned in docs but not implemented.
